rule: label is the guide entry (taxonomy/components.json) that the guide's own definitions give when everything about the element is known, including what activating it does. When the picture alone would earn a different entry, write that entry in looks_like. For example, an <a href> styled as a filled button is label: Link, looks_like: Button. Leave label out when you cannot decide: an unlabelled candidate counts towards stability, never towards accuracy. Tools never write label or looks_like.

candidates.label: Link
candidates.note: An <a href> styled as a filled primary button: the case the spike exists for.
